top_signals.title: U.S. Treasury yields inch lower as investors await key inflation report
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury yields inched lower on Wednesday as investors awaited the latest CPI inflation reading ahead of a flurry of economic data this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: BHP, Union Make Bid to Avert Strike at Top Chile Copper Mine
top_signals.summary: A union representing more than 1,000 workers at Escondida in Chile said it’s holding wage talks with operator BHP Group in a last-ditch effort to avert a strike at the world’s biggest copper mine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trezor reduces resellers as a ‘preventative step’ amid Ledger tampering reports
top_signals.summary: CCO Danny Sanders said he had notified certain hardware wallet resellers that they would be removed from Trezor’s list of authorized entities starting Jan. 1.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
